doc: The one 'in combat' rule (scripts/match/in_combat.gd). A Hunter or a Boki is in combat for window_s seconds after it deals or takes damage in a fight: a hit on or from a Hunter, a Boki, a monster or Blight. Healing, falls, wall slams, heat, friendly fire and damage to yourself don't count. A Boki's fight is its owner's too. Hunter shield refill, a Boki's own mending, the drive music, the bots' slow tick and a Boki's refused orders all read it, so they switch on the same frame. The source publishes no combat timer [gap]: 5 s is the old Hunter regen wait, kept as the one shared value.
